What am I looking at?

  • Lines — a flight from Singapore Changi. A moving dot is a plane.
  • Dashed line — the flight makes one stop on the way (same plane).
  • Colour — each region (or airline, if you switch the view) gets its own colour.
  • Standing Cylinder Bars — one per city. Taller means more airlines fly there.
  • Grey bar — no direct Changi flight; you'd change planes to get there.
  • Red bar — Changi used to fly there, but the route hasn't come back.
  • ✈ badge — the airport itself. Tap any bar, badge, or line to see details.
